intentFrontmatter.title: Errors must not be swallowed
intentFrontmatter.rule: A caught error must be rethrown, wrapped in a typed error, or logged with its cause. An empty catch block, or one that only returns a default, hides failures.

intentBody: A caught error must be rethrown, wrapped in a typed error, or logged with its cause. An empty catch block, or one that only returns a default, hides failures.
notes: The catch discards the error and returns a default, hiding every failure mode behind null.
